question: For each offering department and school where the course material status is 'RQ' and the offering department is either Chemistry or Biology, provide the number of unique subjects and the minimum total units for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH DeptSchoolRQStats AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME), LibrarySubjects2014FA AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2014FA') SELECT l.SUBJECT_TITLE, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.window_column, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units FROM LibrarySubjects2014FA AS l JOIN DeptSchoolRQStats AS d ON l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = d.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT s1.academic_year, s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.material_count, s1.min_term_code, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.ISBN, s2.units_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY s1.academic_year, s1.min_term_code

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS subcnt, MIN(MEET_TIME) AS mintime, AVG(CASE WHEN equivalent_subjects IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + LENGTH(equivalent_subjects) - LENGTH(REPLACE(equivalent_subjects, ',', '')) END) AS avgeqisub FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, subcnt, avgeqisub, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone, COALESCE(mat.material_count, 0) AS num_required_or_optional_materials FROM inner_cte AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.dept = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID AND c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY c.TERM_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS mat ON tbltmp.term = mat.TERM_CODE AND tbltmp.dept = mat.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE) = MASTER_SUBJECT_ID THEN cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME), rollup_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.COURSE WHERE c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, cip_code_variance FROM rollup_cte ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT subq1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, subq1.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, subq1.TIP_TERM_CODE, subq1.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, subq1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.cip_code_variance FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON subq1.COURSE_NUMBER = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER LEFT JOIN subq2 ON ssc.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_tip_material_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lrmd.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY lrmd.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records, MAX(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_library_warehouse_date, MAX(td.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_tip_warehouse_date FROM inner_cte JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_material_status, inner_cte.total_records ORDER BY inner_cte.total_records DESC

WITH LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS (SELECT l.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.TERM_CODE, l.SUBJECT_ID, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) OVER (ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS l JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), SubjectRecordCountVariance AS (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.SUBJECT_ID, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.ISBN, lrm.SUBJECT_TITLE, lrm.window_column, srv.record_count_variance FROM LibraryReserveMaterialDetails AS lrm LEFT JOIN SubjectRecordCountVariance AS srv ON lrm.SUBJECT_ID = srv.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY lrm.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance, STDDEV(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_stddev, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` ON TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT WHERE SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND NOT inner_cte1.enrolled_students_variance < avg_stats.avg_variance * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS variance_category, inner_cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_stats), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 GROUP BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), admin_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.coefficient_of_variation, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON inner_cte2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT vs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, JOIN admin_stats AS ast ON vs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ast.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY vs.enrolled_students_variance DESC
